method: Each candidate voice spoke the pack lines with the pack prompt (take 0, seed 4100) and went through the shipped processing chain. Per-clip judge: 1-10 with transcript check. Comparative judge: all candidates of one line in one request, scored against each other, run in two orders and averaged.
